title: Ada bar Gershon
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Terumot 10:6: “Rabbi Ze’irah, Ada bar Gershon, Rabbi Burai, Rabbi Levi bar Palta,” etc. This statement is cited in Chullin 98a in the name of Rav Shaman bar Abba, who said that Rav Idi bar Idi bar Gershom said that Levi bar Parta said, etc.
